pencereler.0-5: Over a thousand people died on a steamboat close to shore. Fire spread through
pencereler.5-12: the whole ship in minutes. So why could nobody escape on a boat surrounded by water? The life preservers
pencereler.12-20: were thirteen years old and crumbling. Some were packed with iron bars to reach the legal weight. They dragged people under instead
pencereler.20-30: of holding them up. The lifeboats were wired to the deck and would not launch. The inspector had passed it all. He went to prison.

segmentler.metin: The General Slocum fire burned with over a thousand dead.
It took only a fire in a forward storage room.
So how could a fire in a forward storage room do this?
The answer is safety equipment that passed inspection but did not work — and it is why US steamboat inspection was overhauled and life preservers got material standards and expiry rules.
